about: Where each talk, poster and workshop on /research/ took place. City-level coordinates only. Every card in the Presentations section must be listed under exactly one place, and its venue line must name that city; scripts/build_talk_map.py checks both. A place with 'attended' instead of 'cards' is an event I took part in without presenting, marked with an open ring; its value is the id of the element on the page that says so.
